title: Make a Before and After Photo Video on iPhone for Stories
description: Turn a photo edit into a before-and-after reveal video on iPhone, sized for Stories, Reels and TikTok (9:16, 4:5, 1:1). The fastest way and tips that get views.
h1: How to make a before and after photo video on iPhone
card_summary: A reveal video of your edit in 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1, ready for Stories and Reels.
quick_answer: After you edit a photo in Halatto, open Export and choose the video option: a divider sweeps across the photo from the original to the film look. Pick Original, 9:16 (Stories, Reels, TikTok), 4:5 (feed) or 1:1, and tap Share video. Doing the same in a video editor means exporting two images and animating a mask by hand.
intro: Before-and-after reveals are some of the most-watched photo posts: people want to see what the edit changed.
Here is the quick way to make one on iPhone from a vintage edit, and how to format it for each platform.

sections.heading: The manual way, for comparison
paragraphs: Without a built-in export you would save the original and the edited photo, put both on a timeline in a video editor such as CapCut or iMovie, add a wipe transition or animate a mask, then export at the right size. It works, but it takes minutes per photo.

tips.heading: Tips for reveals that get watched
items: Choose photos where the change is obvious: a sharp, cold phone photo turned warm and grainy.
Put the look's name in your caption; people ask which filter it is.
Post a carousel of the final photos after the reveal.

faq.question: Can I make a before and after video in the Photos app?
faq.answer: Not directly. Photos can compare an edit by tapping it, but it cannot export a reveal video.

faq.question: Does the video include a watermark?
faq.answer: The App Store screenshot of the export shows a small Halatto mark in the corner of the video.

faq.question: Which apps can I share the video to?
faq.answer: Any app in the iOS share sheet, including Instagram, TikTok, Messages and Photos.
